title: Koszul Hom colimit is the alternating Cech complex
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $f_1,\ldots,f_r\in A$, and let $M^\bullet$ be a cochain complex of $A$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. For $e\ge1$ form the shifted negative Koszul complex $I^\bullet(f_1^e,\ldots,f_r^e)$ [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex] with $I^i=K^{i-1}(f_1^e,\ldots,f_r^e)$ for $i\le0$ and $I^i=0$ for $i>0$. The canonical map from the filtered colimit over $e$ of the Hom complexes $\operatorname{Hom}_A^\bullet(I^\bullet(f_1^e,\ldots,f_r^e),M^\bullet)$ [def-pur-hom-complex] to the alternating Cech total complex [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex], whose $p$-th row is $\prod_{i_0<\cdots<i_p}M^\bullet_{f_{i_0}\cdots f_{i_p}}$, is a quasi-isomorphism.
